scope:
Audit actual callers across the disruptive cohesion revision.

Imports the strict ELF64 parser from cohesion-codegen.py. Only documented,
side-aware demangled API role/type correspondences are normalized. Every emitted
instruction/data byte, relocation offset/kind/value/addend remains literal.
Differences are findings to inspect, not failures to normalize away.

normalizations.source_roots: both mapped to /sixdb by compiler; actual assertion strings remain literal
normalizations.before_SP_physical_helpers: ordinary namespace -> author; private helpers not merged
normalizations.before_HT_value_payload: insert_slow second argument std::array<unsigned char,N> -> std::array<std::byte,N>; numeric controls unchanged

limits: Literal ELF object comparison, not linked placement or timings. Source/contract changes are real; unmatched or changed bodies require inspection. No body match is inferred merely from a renamed API.

final_source_identity.capture_reference: Root supplied exact frozen R4 capture; local frozen manifest, every manifest source file and every actual compiler dependency independently verified here.
final_source_identity.before_label: f153420002520213e1496a97559f0118bbd1ad94 + TP point oracle-only harness patch

recording_contract.instructions: Literal bytes, function size and section alignment; no instruction/register/immediate normalization.
recording_contract.relocations: Every offset, kind, canonical target, target-symbol value and addend retained.
recording_contract.data: Every non-executable allocated section, including x86 processor-specific unwind, initialization arrays and zero-initialized NOBITS storage; size/type/flags/alignment/relocations retained. Duplicate section spellings retain separate occurrence identities. Coverage independently checked against every ELF section header.
recording_contract.function_aliases: Every nonempty STT_FUNC symbol retained. ABI-distinct C1/C2/C3 and D0/D1/D2 entry names retain a variant suffix; aliases are never deduplicated.
recording_contract.normalizations: Only documented before-side semantic API/type role names plus declared compiler source-root prefix mapping. Unmatched and changed labels/bodies remain findings.
recording_contract.final_TP_role: Before field_filter maps to public predicate; historical private field_predicate remains an accepted byte-object template for older probe inputs.
recording_contract.configured_flags: Actual Release -O3 -g, warning flags, C++23, hidden visibility, function/data sections, strict FP, per-target vectorization disables and per-profile march/mtune/tune macros. No NDEBUG.
recording_contract.diagnostic_differences: Explicit cross target/toolchain selection; compiler source-root prefix map uses /sixdb rather than CMake dot. Dependency/output paths and debug-only sections are not compared as runtime payload.
recording_contract.limits: Object code is not linked placement, runtime qualification or a speed comparison. Ordinary example program and effects-contract changes can change bodies; a type-role correspondence does not assert semantic equality.

inspected_findings.unchanged_primitives: All490 compiled SeriesPack readers, the TuplePack word-reader body and TuplePack initializer body match per profile, including every constant and unwind record.
inspected_findings.changed_consumers: SeriesPack ordinary/integration and filter composition retain initialization, source-identity/effects and writer-call changes. StreamPack keeps constrained-effect/type-label differences and changed capacity admission. Bec ordinary uses the new block/proof boundary. Unmatched symbols are retained, not interpreted as eliminated work.
inspected_findings.tuplepack_ordinary_main: Same byte length on all3 profiles. The only differing instruction bytes are the overflow error ordinal7→8 after adding effects: NEON offset0x740 (mov w8,#7→#8), AVX2 offset0x9b9 and AVX512 offset0x96c. Relocation/type labels and diagnostic strings still differ and remain literal.
inspected_findings.hashtable_constructors: Both changed constructor records per profile have identical machine bytes. Their literal relocation labels point at renamed local SeriesPack attach used-array constants; those old/new constants have equal bytes. These remain strict mismatches, not a speed cost or an extra role normalization.
inspected_findings.prepared_predicate: Before field_filter now compares to the final public predicate role. Its two actual filter bodies remain changed: NEON8676→8692B each; AVX2 9066→9103B and9126→9159B; AVX5128692→8716B and8695→8719B. No instruction, register, immediate or relocation difference is normalized away.
inspected_findings.new_selection_check: After-only source; no baseline body and no before/after performance inference.
inspected_findings.parser_correction: Historical parser omitted non-PROGBITS allocated sections. Final records additionally include46 x86 unwind sections,24 zero-initialized storage sections and12 initialization-array sections. The historical receipt is unchanged.
